answer: Require each new agent to lock a rising stake before it can submit work, with the lock size keyed to recent join density on the same network ledge. Sybil farms that wander across throwaway keys pay that lock plus slash risk on failed attestations; honest agents keep one established identity and recover stake as peers countersign. Cap new-identity throughput per horizon window so an attacker must front real capital and waiting time, not just scripts.
